title: Well made. Small containers
text: Well made. Small containers. these organizers are small, but well made.  These aren't big enough for organizing a clothing or lingerie drawer,  but would be great for make up or jewelry.

product_metadata.title: SMARTAKE 13-Piece Drawer Organizer with Non-Slip Silicone Pads, 5-Size Desk Drawer Organizer Trays Storage Tray for Makeup, Jewelries, Utensils in Bedroom Dresser, Office and Kitchen (Clear)
features: Multiple Sizes - 5 different sizes and 13 pieces trays offer you customize combinations to store stuff and organize drawer for your specific needs. Size: 8.9 x 6 x 2 inches (2 pack), 8.9 x 3.3 x 2 inches(3 pack), 5.9 x 5.9 x 2 inches(1 pack), 5.9 x 2.9 x 2 inches(4 pack), 3 x 3 x 2 inches(3 pack).

Durable and Non-Slip Material - The clear drawer organizers made by unbreakable plastic, ensure the long life of use. Silicone non-slip pads at the bottom of the bin prevent the box from moving freely when dragging the drawer.

Drawer Space Organizer - Absolutely fit different size drawers, it’s able to use in dresser, office, kitchen and bathroom. Ideal for arranging your toiletries, makeup tools, cosmetic, office supplies, kitchen utensils, jewelry and more.
Customize and Stackable Trays - Individual organizer cases can be stacked and sorted out your space easily.

Save your Times - Clear drawer organizers can save your time to organize and find your stuff, it’s easy to find and use your items in the drawer, keep your space neat, help you get a neat lifestyle and enjoy more.
